items.title: Lou Marini interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 15, 2023
items.q: The transcript only identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer. There is no mention of any prior personal or professional relationship between Lou Marini and Monk Rowe.

ctx.x: Lou was interviewed via Zoom on June 15, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and it’s a privilege to talk with Lou Marini today, who is in Alabama with the James Taylor band, is that correct?
Yeah. Gulf Shores, Alabama. It’s really beautiful. You can’t go swimming though, the red flag is up.
